question: A sum of Rs. 9,600 was invested partly at the rate of 8% and the rest at the rate of 10% p.a. simple interest. Total interest received from both the investments was Rs. 3,500 after 4 years. The sum (in Rs.) invested at the rate of 10% p.a. was:
solution:
Formula:

SI = PRT/100, where

SI = Simple Interest, P = Principal

R = Rate, T = Time

Calculation:

Let the sum invested at 10% be "a"

⇒ Sum invested at 8% = Rs 9600 - a

⇒ SI for "a" = a times 10 times 4over100 =&
